question: Which Union Minister inaugurated the Startup Mahakumbh 2025 and referred to his visit as “an experience of a lifetime”?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Piyush Goyal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Union Minister of **Commerce and Industry**, **Shri Piyush Goyal**, inaugurated the **Startup Mahakumbh**, a premier event celebrating the entrepreneurial spirit of India.
 
• The Minister described his visit to the event as **“an experience of a lifetime”**, highlighting the vibrant energy, diverse innovations, and the scale of participation from young entrepreneurs across the **country**.
 
• The **Startup Mahakumbh** aims to bring together all stakeholders of the **startup ecosystem**, including **investors**, **incubators**, **accelerators**, and **industry leaders** to foster collaboration and growth.
 
• The event is supported by the **Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)** under the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**, showcasing the government’s commitment to making **India** a global innovation hub.
 
• The organizing committee includes leading industry bodies such as **ASSOCHAM**, **nasscom**, **Bootstrap Foundation**, **TiE**, and **IVCA**, working together to showcase **Bharat’s** startup prowess.
